summary: Implemented grid-sampled patch iteration. Changes: monai/data/grid_dataset.py adds PatchIter (prepends channel whole-dim entry, normalizes start_pos with ensure_tuple, delegates to iter_patch with copy_back=False), reworks GridPatchDataset(dataset, patch_iter, transform=None, with_coordinates=True) with worker partitioning, per-patch apply_transform, and the len() NotImplementedError check, and fixes np.float to float in the PatchDataset docstring. monai/data/utils.py: iter_patch yields (patch view, integer start/stop coordinate array) with updated docstring; set_rnd skips double-underscore keys. monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter. docs/source/data.rst adds a PatchIter autodoc entry. tests/test_grid_dataset.py is new with test_shape and test_loading_array using the pinned spec values. Not run: per instructions, pytest was not executed, so the tests and the pinned random values are unverified. Pre-existing over-120-char lines in utils.py get_valid_patch_size docstring were left untouched. Nothing committed.
